verdicts.reason: The report prints a stored expected value instead of reading the game and misses a changed health value. Both are listed false passes for the observer.
The sky is required to have lightning without rain. A dry storm that rains is the leaf's red condition.
The untouched site at play zoom shows mineral flora and fauna, two distinguishable soils, a rainless lightning sky and five distinct weather states.
Hazardous pool liquid becomes fresh water at the pump boundary. This is an explicit false pass and the red condition.
The cue starts after harmful exposure. This is the red condition.
Visible vent and idle-native cues appear about one in-game hour before bloom, without the optional message. Only eligible idle natives hold still, and the worker reaches shelter before the dose.
A fully sealed worker takes an ambient metal dose while the gear keeps its hit points. Wearer protection must not be inferred from item survival.
The exposed control is harmed, roofed and fully sealed workers keep their starting health, and partial equipment follows its rule.
Metal clears on its own under ordinary care. A slow natural decay labelled permanent is a listed false pass.
A low saved trace is purged through the normal health bill, with an attributable operation and ingredient consumption.
The acid sensory injury heals away and Sight returns to baseline. The leaf's red condition covers effects that heal away and restored capacity.
A completed harvest pays no metal, and the rich assay does not follow the payout.
Three seed-bearing bound sleepers root a young thornwood. The galled animal binds and drops edible galls while remaining seedless.
A ranged hit should start a toxic detonation. A shot suush that simply dies is the red condition.
Lined taps must resist prying. A lined tap taking pry damage is the red condition.
Wild drinking suppresses output and it recovers afterward. Tame shearing supplies vexxith without killing the animal.
Sealed diagonal barriers must stop the chain. Leaking through a sealed corner is the red condition.
A dramatic blast throws none of the identified goods. This is the red condition and a listed false pass.
Work must pause without losing stock. 200 L of input vanishes with no product.
All-off must not cure lasting health or destroy stock. Here the poisoning is erased and the banked liquid is lost.
The prepared forty finish routine work without new ambient injury and stock reconciles. The exposed expedition and wild competition still carry risk.
Reload loses the grove bindings. This is the walk's red condition.
The poisoning clears on its own without advanced treatment. The owner forbids self-clearance, and the 'persistent' label does not change that.
The supposed permanent sensory injury leaves the original capacity intact. A label does not count as sensory harm.
The visible vent and animal cues must give about one hour of warning. The optional message only supplements them and cannot replace a 500-tick cue.
Roof protection works for only one ambient route, since the roofed worker still takes acid burns. This is the red condition.
The flame leaks through a sealed diagonal corner. The design requires both straight and diagonal sealed barriers to stop the chain.
Goods are destroyed and respawned elsewhere with new ids. This is a listed false pass, not thrown identified goods.
All-off must not cure lasting health. The poisoning disappears and does not return after re-enable.
Metal must be growth-scaled. A young tree paying the same 12 steel as a full-grown one is not scaled, and the lower assay does not follow the payout.

ambiguities: The permanent_acid leaf says acid 'can' leave permanent harm, and permanence is shown by a finite batch rather than a fixed rate. A single case that fully heals, as in e11, is read as the red condition, but it could alternatively be one non-permanent sample within a batch.
